description: Header file for the PTM driver core functions specific to Danube/Amazon-SE/AR9 platforms, defining constants, data structures, and external function declarations related to the MIPS-based ADSL PTM implementation.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_get_fw_ver
methods.description: Retrieves the firmware version (major and minor) for the PTM driver.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_init_chip
methods.description: Initializes the PTM chip with the provided platform device.

methods.name: ifx_pp32_start
methods.description: Starts the PP32 processor with the specified parameter.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_proc_read_regs
methods.description: Reads the PTM registers for diagnostic purposes.
